meaning.en: The office or period of a manager.
meaning.vi: Văn phòng hoặc thời kỳ của một nhà quản lý.

meaning_vi: chức quản lý, chức quản đốc, chức giám đốc

sentences.en: Also, they were thinking in terms of managership, not leadership.

sentences.en: Pass study, oneself had certain knowledge to project managership and action.

sentences.en: Managership and leadership are often thought of as the same thing.

sentences.en: After six years, he is offerred the managership of a branch in Scotland.

sentences.en: This is why an understanding of motivation is so important to leadership and managership.
